links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of competing multimodal LLMs compared on the same retina cases
links.effect: Full-context accuracy: GPT-4.o 78.4%, Claude 73.0%, Gemini 29.7% (P<.001). Image-only: Claude 73.7%, GPT-4.o 63.2%, Gemini 31.6% (P<.001).
links.quote: In full-context cases, GPT-4.o achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (78.4%), followed by Claude (73.0%) and Gemini (29.7%) (P < .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Pro) on retinal diagnostic cases under different prompt contexts without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
